metadata.scenario_context: Sophia has been promoted to the position of a Team Manager at her workplace, and her friends are throwing her a surprise party to celebrate her accomplishment.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message: Hey Lucas, have you thought about what we should get Sophia for her surprise party? I was thinking... maybe we should give her yellow flowers. They symbolize friendship and joy. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: Yellow flowers are nice, but I think we should choose something more personal. Maybe something related to her achievements, like a nice pen set for her new role as a manager? It would show how proud we are of her accomplishments. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message: I get that a pen set is a nice idea, but yellow flowers really capture the celebration vibe. They’re cheerful, just like Sophia. Plus, we can always add a personal note to go along with them. Anyway, don’t you think it’s also essential to talk about what really matters in life? Like, do you think one of our main goals should be making our parents proud? I don’t... I just don’t see it that way.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lucas
shared_prefix.message: I understand your point about the flowers being cheerful, but I still believe a pen set would be more meaningful for her new position. About making our parents proud, for me, that's a core goal in life. My parents sacrificed a lot for me, and I want to honor that. It's very important to me, even if you see things differently.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mark
shared_prefix.message: I mean, at the end of the day it's all the same, right? Everyone has their own motivations. People figure it out in their own ways. I don’t really see meaningful differences here. But back to the flowers—don’t you think they’d really brighten up the party? It’s a celebration for Sophia, and I just feel like we should lean into that vibe.
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Lucas
